profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ SoFi
profile.summary:
Relentless Learner // Rigorous Thinker // Solutions Focussed⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ 

I am a gritty software engineer, with a breadth of experience in back end, front end, cloud, data infrastructure, and security development. What draws me to this career and the tech world is the constant evolution and innovation. You are relentlessly taught new things every day, almost forced to actually, but being a tenacious learner, I love it, crave it, and welcome it. It feeds my hunger for progress. I am passionate about creating software because, to me, it is the greatest form of leverage in engineering. These days, all you really need is a computer and some like-minded, motivated people to build something of high societal impact. Having been at multiple successful startups, I can affirm this belief with anecdotal experience. With that said, I am truly confident that technology will help accomplish my overarching vision of one day creating a social impact and change. It is a tall task, yes, but anything worth accomplishing is never easy.
⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀  ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀   ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀   ⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀ Areas that currently excite me are machine learning applications, software development, software security, and human-computer interaction. With my talents and skills, I hope to create meaningful technology that engages all kinds of people, especially those who are technologically marginalized and underserved. I aim to bridge social gaps and empower society through inclusion and accessibility while embracing diversity. I am always looking for new opportunities and experiences that leverage technology into a proponent for equity, compassion, and applicability for all communities and lifestyles.
